description: Source code for Bluetooth Hearing Access Service (HAS) client implementation in Zephyr OS, managing BLE connections, characteristic discovery, notifications, and preset control.

methods.name: bt_has_client_cb_register
methods.description: Registers callback functions for HAS client events.

methods.name: bt_has_client_discover
methods.description: Initiates discovery of the Hearing Access Service on a BLE connection.

methods.name: bt_has_client_conn_get
methods.description: Retrieves the BLE connection associated with a given HAS instance.

methods.name: bt_has_client_presets_read
methods.description: Reads preset information from the connected hearing device.

methods.name: bt_has_client_preset_set
methods.description: Sets the active preset on the hearing device, optionally synchronously.

methods.name: bt_has_client_preset_next
methods.description: Switches to the next preset, optionally synchronously.

methods.name: bt_has_client_preset_prev
methods.description: Switches to the previous preset, optionally synchronously.
